name: Multi-view Alpha-Weighted Error Accumulation
definition: A technique to map 2D imagespace errors back to 3D Gaussian primitives by computing importance and pruning scores via alpha-weighted aggregation across multiple views, differentiating important from redundant Gaussians and avoiding overfitting to single-view occlusions.
summary: Multi-view Alpha-Weighted Error Accumulation maps 2D photometric errors to 3D Gaussians using alpha-weighted aggregation across multiple views to prevent single-view overfitting.
